newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Timothy Ramey said Monday he upgraded agribusiness giant Archer Daniels Midland Co to a buy from a hold, but cut his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $1.20 a share from $1.35.
-- He also cut his fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.45 a share from $1.55.

-- "Essentially all of the remainder of calendar 1997 should have depressed margins in corn sweeteners and the soybean crush margins will not recover meaningfully until the new crop is in, in the second quarter of fiscal 1998," Ramey said in a report.
-- Ramey told Reuters he upgraded ADM on the basis of the current price and the outlook for margin improvements later on.

-- "We're asking investors to look to the 1998 fiscal year, particularly the second half, to see significant EPS (earnings per shre) momentum," Ramey said in his report. "We expect that HFCS (high fructose corn syrup) pricing, which was down 35 percent (or more) in calendar 1997 will firm sharply in January 1998. Also, ADM's cost of corn and soybeans should ease starting in the (second quarter) FY98."
-- Ramey said his price target is $26 a share.
-- ADM shares on Monday were up 1/8 at 17-3/4.
